review_snapshot.finding: Working stroke has approximately 4+2 nm phases. Analysis uses crossbridge stiffness 0.7 pN/nm (data not shown). Fitted load distances are 1.3 nm for inverse overall lifetime and 2.7 nm for first-phase rate; resisting load slows the first phase.
review_snapshot.limits: The exact 0.6 nm prestroke slip length was not located in accessed main article. Exact 5.5 nm appears in Stam’s later model, not established here as an NMIIA measurement. Optical load, smooth-muscle construct, event censoring and low ATP differ from target. No supplement-based absence claim is made. Discussion p.984 says the initial rapid, possibly Pi-associated transition is too fast for this setup; chemical-state assignment is interpretive.
review_snapshot.reported_uncertainty: Table 1 gives theoretical lifetime SEM and fit-rate SEM/correlation; these do not supply SEM for every distance/stiffness. No numeric uncertainty for 0.7 stiffness located.

relations.statement: Whole-filament contour, central bare zone, transverse arm offset and numerical backbone discretization are different quantities. Shared microscopy provenance does not join them in a current fit.
assumptions: State/preparation, image projection and topology must be specified before mapping each measured dimension to a model coordinate.

relations.statement: For a small-deflection uniform rod, axial stiffness EA/L and clamped-free end-deflection stiffness3EI/L^3 depend on length/boundary conditions. Builder uses its declared EA/rest and kappa/length coefficients, with backbone constraint flags. These mappings do not transfer scallop S2 results to a human assembled backbone.
assumptions: Uniform linear rod, specified boundary conditions and specified molecular/assembled geometry are source-model assumptions, not validated properties of the current target.
No new constants, priors or runtime contribution are inferred.

relations.statement: Structural widths and atomic fragment cross-sections do not automatically equal bead radii. The current builder assigns endpoint half-cylinder mass using radius² and segment length.
assumptions: A drag-equivalent coarse radius and mass mapping require their own definition; folded 10S structure and negative-stain widths are not that calibration.

relations.statement: A rigid lever chord relation stroke=2L sin(theta/2) can test declared consistency. It does not identify the transverse200nm arm offset with a molecular lever or establish the current7.5nm from primary measurement.
assumptions: Rigid rotation about a specified fulcrum and same displacement coordinate; actual current stepping amplitude is not verified here.

relations.statement: The value1 selects whole-object assembly/disassembly bookkeeping. A folded myosin molecule, a biochemical oligomer and an intact coarse dormant minifilament are different observational units.
assumptions: Closed two-state stationary reserve relation in the code is conditional; this review does not establish its validity from scattering, EM or FRAP.

relations.statement: Current mass=rho*(4/3)*pi*r^3 uses a homogeneous sphere assumption. Nominal diameter to radius is a geometric conversion; aqueous-density proxy is separate from liposome DLS size.
assumptions: No lumen-density measurement, membrane mass partition or native size distribution established; diameter fit confidence interval is not a population radius band.

relations.statement: Current cargo count sums rounded total-motor-object counts times per-class fractions and assigns one carrier relation per cargo node. Synthetic multiple-motor liposomes and distinct motor families do not measure those total-pool fractions.
assumptions: Denominator must specify motor molecule/complex versus vesicle and compartment/time/state; source experiments do not establish the0.8/0.6allocation.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: n_backbone is a numerical node count; backbone segment length is contour-input/(n_backbone-1). Assembled count and reserved objects are obtained before placement. No molecular stoichiometry measurement follows from the node count.

Head coordinates are displaced transversely from backbone anchor beads by head_offset. This is not a longitudinal bare-zone distance or molecular lever-arm length. arm_seg refines the numerical chain.

Builder assigns axial coefficient EA/rest and bending coefficient kappa/segment_length, with separate arm orientation and internal-arm triples. It also flags backbone segments constrained. Coefficient construction alone does not demonstrate its active runtime force contribution. Radius-dependent mass uses half-segment cylinders at endpoints, not an isolated spherical motor-head mass.

Rigid-lever chord comparison computes 2 asin(stroke/(2 lever_arm)) subject to positive lengths and stroke<=2 lever_arm. This geometric check is not an experimental joint fit; source comments claiming independent measurements remain unadjudicated.

object_life is a 0/1 selector. Assembled and dormant reserve counts use a conditional closed two-state stationary ratio; the selector is not a measured lifetime and does not establish biochemical equivalence of intact dormant objects and free folded molecules.

Counts are rounded motor count times cargo fraction, summed over motor classes. Each carrier is one free node with mass=density*(4/3)*pi*radius^3 and unresolved membrane. This differs from a vesicle bearing an experimentally variable motor team.

The current generic motor pool is divided by an object-count fraction into MT-owning sliding and cargo-owning roles; rates are shared by bindings. KIF5-like dimers and Eg5 tetramers, or cortical dynein and activated DDB, are not shown to be one measured interconverting molecular pool by this bookkeeping.
The declared lever-arm/chord result is returned as build metadata. Inspecting this does not establish realized stepping amplitude or native runtime behavior.

GFP calibration and size model feed population motor-density estimation. Separate AMPPNP/ATP cohorts and unequal n; not same-object pairs.
Reuses TM08; purified moving-complex observations do not sample the fraction of total cell dynein engaged in cargo transport.
Abstract-only species/construct limits; source role is not a measured generic-pool partition.
